nodes.title: DaSiWa RIFE SPAN Refine / comparison
widgets_values:
Low-resolution video + audio: 8 + 4 + 2 steps, CFG 1.

Pass 1 scale 0.5. Pass 2/3 scale 1.0; no latent upscale.

Final-pass decode -> RIFE 2x -> NomosUni SPAN 2x -> MP4.

Final-pass audio: no time stretching; FPS doubled. No mosaic.

This is an experiment, not a verified audio-quality fix.

Compare with the original RIFE SPAN using the same fixed seed,
image, prompts, LoRAs, duration and resolution.

Slower than first-pass-only; GPU quality/speed need testing.
